description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'MenuServiceTest' used for testing the MenuService component within the OrangeHRM core service layer. It includes setup and teardown routines, and test methods for verifying menu items for different user roles (admin and supervisor). The tests mock user authentication and HTTP request contexts, and validate the menu structures returned by the service.

classes.name: MenuServiceTest
classes.description: Unit test class for the MenuService, testing menu item retrieval for different user roles.
